items.title: Sensorimotor and Molecular Mechanisms of Non-Contact ACL Injury: An Integrative Hypothesis.
items.summary: This clinical commentary proposes an integrative sensorimotor and molecular model for non-contact ACL injury, emphasizing the decisive role of feed-forward hamstring tension and titin stiffening before ground contact, and clarifying the importance of pre-contact landing strategies and eccentric strength training for prevention.
items.curatedReason: 这份述评提示我们，非接触性 ACL 损伤可能不仅仅是力学问题，而与落地前的本体感觉、肌肉预激活和分子机制（肌联蛋白硬化）密切相关。在 ACL 预防中，请重新审视落地前的准备策略和腘绳肌离心力量训练的必要性。
items.titleZh: 非接触性ACL损伤的传感器运动与分子机制：一个整合性假说
items.summaryZh: 该临床评论提出了一个整合性的传感器运动与分子模型，解释非接触性ACL损伤的机制，强调接触前腘绳肌张力和肌联蛋白硬化的关键作用，并阐明了接触前着陆策略和离心力量训练在损伤预防中的重要性。
items.curatedReasonEn: This commentary suggests non-contact ACL injury might not solely be a mechanical issue, but significantly linked to pre-contact proprioception, muscle pre-activation, and molecular mechanisms like titin stiffening. When addressing ACL prevention, re-evaluate the necessity of pre-contact landing strategies and eccentric hamstring strength training.
items.limitation: 本模型为理论性假说，尚待实证研究验证。
items.limitationEn: This model is a theoretical hypothesis that requires empirical validation.

items.title: Comparison of short-foot and toe-curl exercises on movement control during single-leg landing after ACL reconstruction: An exploratory randomized controlled trial.
items.summary: A multicenter exploratory RCT (N=38) found that short-foot exercise (SFE) led to earlier improvements in hip adduction excursion during single-leg landing compared to toe-curl exercise (TCE) in ACLR patients, with between-group difference of -6.30° (95% CI, -9.19 to -3.41; ES, -1.41) at 6 weeks.
items.curatedReason: ACL 重建术后患者的运动控制训练，短足运动（SFE）在改善额状面运动控制方面似乎优于趾卷曲运动（TCE），并且改善出现得更早。这提示你可以考虑将 SFE 优先整合到 ACLR 术后康复方案中。
items.titleZh: ACL 重建术后单腿落地运动控制中短足运动与趾卷曲运动的比较：一项探索性随机对照试验
items.summaryZh: 一项多中心探索性 RCT（N=38）发现，ACL 重建术后患者在单腿落地时，短足运动（SFE）在改善髋关节内收偏移方面比趾卷曲运动（TCE）有更早的改善，6 周时组间差异为 -6.30°（95% CI, -9.19 至 -3.41；ES, -1.41）。
items.curatedReasonEn: For ACL reconstruction patients, short-foot exercise (SFE) appears superior to toe-curl exercise (TCE) in improving frontal-plane movement control, with earlier improvements noted. This suggests you might prioritize integrating SFE into ACLR post-operative rehabilitation protocols.
items.limitation: 这是一项探索性研究，样本量相对较小（38人），可能限制了结果的普遍性。
items.limitationEn: This is an exploratory study with a relatively small sample size (38 participants), which may limit the generalizability of the findings.

items.title:
Impact of age and frailty on the effect of a multimodal individualized long-term intervention after stroke: the last-long trial
							| Journal of Rehabilitation Medicine
items.summary: A single-blinded RCT (n=301) found that a stroke coordinator-led, community-based intervention showed no overall functional benefit, but age modified the effect. Participants ≥80 years old were less likely to have a favorable mRS outcome (23.4% vs 57.0%, p=0.004) with intervention, while younger participants showed improved Trail Making Test B scores (-32.2 s, 95% CI -58.0 to -6.4, p=0.015).
items.curatedReason: 这项 RCT 表明，卒中后的长期多模式干预对不同年龄组有差异效应。80 岁以上患者可能不会从干预中获得整体功能改善，甚至有更差结果的倾向，而年轻患者在认知方面可能受益。你在为卒中患者制定长期康复计划时，应根据患者年龄调整干预策略，尤其对老年患者要重新评估方案的适用性。
items.titleZh: 年龄和衰弱对卒中后多模式个体化长期干预效果的影响：LAST-long 试验
items.summaryZh: 一项单盲随机对照试验（n=301）发现，一项由卒中协调员主导的社区干预措施没有显示出总体功能益处，但年龄改变了其效果。80 岁及以上参与者在干预后获得良好改良 Rankin 量表（mRS）结果的可能性较低（23.4% vs 57.0%，p=0.004），而年轻参与者在径迹追踪测试 B 中得分有所改善（-32.2 秒，95% CI -58.0 至 -6.4，p=0.015）。
items.curatedReasonEn: This RCT indicates differential effects of long-term multimodal intervention after stroke across age groups. Patients over 80 years old may not experience overall functional benefit from the intervention, and may even trend toward worse outcomes, while younger patients might benefit cognitively. When developing long-term rehabilitation plans for stroke patients, you should tailor intervention strategies based on age, especially re-evaluating the suitability of plans for older patients.
items.limitation: 本研究主要关注卒中轻度症状的参与者，结果对外推至更严重的卒中患者可能存在局限性。
items.limitationEn: This study primarily focused on participants with mild stroke symptoms, limiting the generalizability of the findings to patients with more severe stroke.

items.title: How Should Practices Manage Credit Card Processing Fees?
items.summary: This article explains the complex rules for physical therapy practices regarding credit card processing fees, noting that Medicare prohibits passing these fees to beneficiaries. It details varying state laws (some strictly prohibit, others permit with limits) and credit card network rules (Visa and Mastercard permit with strict disclosure guidelines and notification requirements), advising practices to consult legal counsel.
items.curatedReason: 这篇文章详细阐述了物理治疗诊所能否将信用卡手续费转嫁给患者的复杂规定，特别指出 Medicare 不允许此操作，且各州法律和信用卡网络规则差异巨大。在你的执业中，务必熟悉你所在州和地区关于附加费的具体法律，并在执行前咨询法律顾问，以避免违规。
items.titleZh: 诊所如何管理信用卡手续费？
items.summaryZh: 本文解释了物理治疗诊所关于信用卡手续费的复杂规定，指出 Medicare 禁止将这些费用转嫁给受益人。文章详细阐述了各州法律（有些严格禁止，有些允许但有限制）和信用卡网络规则（Visa 和 Mastercard 允许，但有严格的披露准则和通知要求）的差异，建议诊所咨询法律顾问。
items.curatedReasonEn: This article details the complex regulations governing whether physical therapy clinics can pass credit card processing fees to patients, specifically noting that Medicare prohibits this and that state laws and credit card network rules vary widely. In your practice, you must be familiar with the specific laws regarding surcharges in your state and region, and consult legal counsel before implementation, to avoid non-compliance.

items.title: Weekly musculoskeletal pain beyond self-reported injury in Italian track-and-field athletes: a 23-week prospective cohort study
items.summary: A 23-week prospective cohort study (n=96) of Italian track-and-field athletes found that musculoskeletal pain was reported in 25.2% of athlete-weeks, but only 8.3% were athlete-labelled injuries. Two-thirds of pain-positive weeks (67.6%) were not labeled as injuries, highlighting that relying on self-reported injury significantly underestimates the symptom burden.
items.curatedReason: 这项前瞻性队列研究强调，仅依赖运动员自报伤病会遗漏大部分疼痛问题。在你的运动康复实践中，应采用基于症状和后果的监测工具，如 OSTRC 问卷，以便更全面地识别和管理运动员的健康问题，而不仅仅是等待他们自报“伤病”。
items.titleZh: 意大利田径运动员自报伤病之外的每周肌肉骨骼疼痛：一项为期 23 周的前瞻性队列研究
items.summaryZh: 一项针对意大利田径运动员的为期 23 周前瞻性队列研究（n=96）发现，25.2% 的运动员周报告有肌肉骨骼疼痛，但仅 8.3% 被运动员标记为伤病。三分之二的疼痛周（67.6%）未被标记为伤病，这表明仅依赖自报伤病会显著低估症状负担。
items.curatedReasonEn: This prospective cohort study highlights that relying solely on athlete-reported injuries misses a significant portion of pain issues. In your sports rehabilitation practice, you should use symptom- and consequence-based monitoring tools, such as the OSTRC questionnaire, to more comprehensively identify and manage athletes' health problems, rather than just waiting for them to report an 'injury'.
items.limitation: 本研究为观察性队列研究，不能建立因果关系，且研究人群仅限于意大利田径运动员，结果可能不完全适用于其他运动项目或人群。
items.limitationEn: This is an observational cohort study, which cannot establish causality. The study population is limited to Italian track-and-field athletes, so the results may not be fully generalizable to other sports or populations.
items.journal: BMC Sports Science, Medicine and Rehabilitation

items.title: Validation study comparing a novel sham acupuncture technique with Park sham acupuncture: A randomized controlled trial
items.summary: A randomized controlled trial (n=66) comparing a novel noninvasive sham acupuncture device with the Park sham device found no significant differences in perceived penetration sensation, pain, or deqi (p > 0.05). Both devices elicited minimal sensory responses (<1.0 on NRS), and the novel device was noninferior, supporting its use as a valid control in acupuncture trials.
items.curatedReason: 这项 RCT 验证了一种新型假针刺设备的有效性，其与市售 Park 假针刺设备表现出可比的假性刺激效应，且未报告不良事件。这为针刺临床试验提供了另一个可信的对照工具，有助于未来更严谨的针刺疗效研究。
items.titleZh: 新型假针刺技术与 Park 假针刺比较的验证研究：一项随机对照试验
items.summaryZh: 一项随机对照试验（n=66）比较了一种新型无创假针刺设备与 Park 假针刺设备，结果显示在感知穿透感、疼痛和得气方面无显著差异（p > 0.05）。两种设备均引起最小的感官反应（NRS <1.0），且新型设备具有非劣效性，支持其作为针刺试验的有效对照。
items.curatedReasonEn: This RCT validated a novel sham acupuncture device, demonstrating comparable sham stimulation effects to the commercially available Park sham acupuncture device, with no reported adverse events. This provides another credible control tool for acupuncture clinical trials, facilitating more rigorous research into acupuncture efficacy in the future.
items.limitation: 本研究的受试者是健康成人，结果可能无法直接外推至实际的疼痛或疾病患者群体。
items.limitationEn: The study participants were healthy adults, so the results may not be directly generalizable to actual pain or disease patient populations.

items.title: Patient Voices in a Digital Space: Thematic Analysis of YouTube Comments on Pelvic Floor Content
items.summary: A thematic analysis of 14.7K YouTube comments on pelvic floor physical therapy (PFPT) videos revealed three major themes: desire for community, healthcare experiences, and desire for knowledge. The platform serves as a vital resource for individuals with pelvic floor disorders, fostering community and empowerment.
items.curatedReason: YouTube 上的盆底物理治疗（PFPT）内容是患者获取信息和建立社区的重要渠道，尤其对于受耻辱感影响且难以获得传统医疗服务的患者。你可以利用这一趋势，加强线上患者教育和支持，但要注意内容的专业性和准确性。
items.titleZh: 数字空间中的患者声音：YouTube 盆底内容评论的主题分析
items.summaryZh: 对 YouTube 盆底物理治疗（PFPT）视频的 1.47 万条评论进行主题分析，发现三大主题：社区渴望、医疗经验和知识渴望。该平台是盆底功能障碍患者的重要资源，促进了社区建设和赋权。
items.curatedReasonEn: YouTube's pelvic floor physical therapy (PFPT) content serves as a vital resource for patients to access information and build community, especially for those affected by stigma and limited access to traditional healthcare. You can leverage this trend to enhance online patient education and support, but ensure the professionalism and accuracy of the content.
items.limitation: 本研究为回顾性定性分析，仅限于 YouTube 平台上的公开评论，可能无法全面反映所有患者的观点和体验。
items.limitationEn: This study is a retrospective qualitative analysis limited to public comments on YouTube, which may not fully reflect the views and experiences of all patients.

items.title: Trends in Australia's physiotherapy workforce: changes and future implications.
items.summary: Between 2013 and 2023, Australia's physiotherapy workforce increased by 70.5% to 35,889, yet 81.0% practiced in metropolitan areas, with males less likely and Indigenous physiotherapists more likely to work in regional, rural, and remote areas.
items.curatedReason: 澳大利亚物理治疗师劳动力分配不均问题依然突出，特别是城乡差距。报告提出的教育实践、激励和支持策略值得中国和美国PT行业思考，以解决偏远地区PT短缺问题。
items.titleZh: 澳大利亚物理治疗师劳动力趋势：变化与未来影响。
items.summaryZh: 2013年至2023年间，澳大利亚物理治疗师劳动力增长70.5%至35,889人，但81.0%仍在都市区执业，男性在城乡和偏远地区执业的可能性较低，而原住民物理治疗师则较高。
items.curatedReasonEn: Workforce maldistribution among Australian physiotherapists, especially between urban and rural areas, remains prominent. The strategies proposed, focusing on education, incentives, and support, are worth considering by the PT industries in China and the US to address PT shortages in remote areas.
items.limitation: 研究基于回顾性数据集，无法建立因果关系。
items.limitationEn: The study relies on retrospective datasets, which prevents establishing causal relationships.

items.title: Upper Limb Neurorehabilitation Using a Hybrid Technology-Enabled Therapy Approach-A Scoping Review.
items.summary: A scoping review identified ten studies on hybrid technology-enabled upper limb neurorehabilitation for adult stroke patients in hospital settings, showing positive outcomes and feasibility for implementation.
items.curatedReason: 本综述显示，针对中风患者的混合技术（如机器人、VR、传感器）上肢神经康复在医院环境中展现出积极效果和可行性。可作为你了解未来技术整合方向的参考。
items.titleZh: 使用混合技术实现的上肢神经康复方法：一项范围综述
items.summaryZh: 一项范围综述确定了针对住院成人中风患者使用混合技术（如机器人、虚拟现实和传感器疗法）进行上肢神经康复的十项研究，结果显示出积极的患者结局和临床实施的可行性。
items.curatedReasonEn: This review indicates that hybrid technology (e.g., robotics, VR, sensor-based) for upper limb neurorehabilitation in stroke patients shows positive outcomes and feasibility in hospital settings. It serves as a reference for future technology integration trends.
items.limitation: 大多数研究为观察性或初步性质，侧重于临床可行性而非长期疗效。
items.limitationEn: Most studies were observational or pilot in nature, focusing on clinical feasibility rather than long-term efficacy.

items.title: Identifying key components for psychosocial interventions in neurorehabilitation: a realist evaluation on young adults with an acquired brain injury.
items.summary: A realist evaluation identified three key program theories for psychosocial interventions in young adults with acquired brain injury: engaging the individual, empowering the community, and equipping professionals.
items.curatedReason: 对于脑损伤年轻成人（含卒中）的心理社会干预，本研究提示有三大支柱：让个体参与、赋能社区、武装专业人员。如果你所在机构的康复方案效果不彰，不妨审视一下是否缺少这几个环节。
items.titleZh: 确定神经康复中心理社会干预的关键组成部分：一项针对获得性脑损伤年轻成人的真实主义评估
items.summaryZh: 一项真实主义评估确定了针对获得性脑损伤（包括中风）年轻成人进行心理社会干预的三个关键项目理论：个体参与、社区赋能和专业人员装备。
items.curatedReasonEn: For psychosocial interventions in young adults with acquired brain injury (including stroke), this study suggests three pillars: individual engagement, community empowerment, and equipping professionals. If your rehabilitation programs are falling short, consider whether these components are adequately addressed.
items.limitation: 研究样本量较小，仅限于英国的年轻成人及服务提供者，可能影响结果的普遍性。
items.limitationEn: The study involved a small sample size, limited to young adults and service providers in the UK, which may affect the generalizability of the findings.

items.title: Motor memory consolidation during sleep after stroke: the rehabilitation timing hypothesis.
items.summary: This review synthesizes evidence for the rehabilitation timing hypothesis in stroke, suggesting that scheduling motor therapy close to sleep could enhance motor memory consolidation and recovery, though direct clinical evidence in stroke populations is lacking.
items.curatedReason: 这篇综述提出了“康复时机假说”，强调将中风后运动康复安排在接近睡眠的时间，可能通过优化睡眠中的运动记忆巩固来增强恢复。这是一个值得你在临床实践中探索的低成本策略。
items.titleZh: 中风后睡眠期间运动记忆巩固：康复时机假说
items.summaryZh: 本综述综合了中风康复时机假说的证据，提出将运动疗法安排在临近睡眠的时间可能增强运动记忆巩固和恢复，尽管目前尚缺乏在卒中人群中直接验证的临床证据。
items.curatedReasonEn: This review introduces the "rehabilitation timing hypothesis," suggesting that scheduling post-stroke motor rehabilitation close to sleep may enhance recovery by optimizing motor memory consolidation during sleep. This is a low-cost strategy worth exploring in your clinical practice.
items.limitation: 目前在卒中人群中直接验证康复时机假说的临床证据尚缺乏，需要更多正式试验。
items.limitationEn: Direct clinical evidence to test the rehabilitation timing hypothesis in stroke populations is currently lacking, and more formal trials are urgently needed.

items.title: An economic evaluation alongside a randomised controlled trial of Scanning Eye trAining as a Rehabilitation Choice compared to sham training for Hemianopia after stroke (the SEARCH trial).
items.summary: An economic evaluation alongside a randomized controlled trial for visual scanning training in post-stroke hemianopia found the intervention's cost-effectiveness ratio of £19,790/QALY was below the NICE threshold, but QALY gain was marginal and non-significant.
items.curatedReason: 对于中风后偏盲患者，视觉扫描训练的成本效益分析显示其略低于英国NICE的成本效益阈值。虽然质量调整生命年（QALY）增益不显著，但可作为你考虑引入该干预时的经济学参考。
items.titleZh: 一项随机对照试验的经济学评估：中风后偏盲患者的扫描眼训练康复选择与假训练（SEARCH试验）
items.summaryZh: 一项针对中风后偏盲患者视觉扫描训练的随机对照试验的经济学评估发现，该干预的成本效益比为19,790英镑/QALY，低于NICE阈值，但QALY增益微弱且不显著。
items.curatedReasonEn: For post-stroke hemianopia, visual scanning training showed a cost-effectiveness ratio slightly below the UK NICE threshold. Although the Quality-Adjusted Life Year (QALY) gain was not significant, this provides an economic reference when considering this intervention.
items.limitation: 视觉扫描训练的QALY增益不显著，经济效益结论尚需更多高水平证据支持。
items.limitationEn: The QALY gain for visual scanning training was not significant, and economic benefit conclusions require more high-level evidence.

items.title: Criterion validity of the Watt-max Test and Test Assessors' judgement of V..O2max achievement in Individuals with Heart Disease
items.summary: This study investigates the criterion validity of the Watt-max Test and assessors' judgment for V̇O2max achievement in individuals with heart disease, relevant for cardiac rehabilitation exercise prescription.
items.curatedReason: Watt-max 测试和评估者主观判断对心脏病患者 V̇O2max 的预测效度尚不明确。因此，在为心肺康复患者开运动处方时，对这两项结果的解读务必谨慎，不能简单等同于实际 V̇O2max。
items.titleZh: Watt-max 测试和测试评估者对心脏病患者 V̇O2max 达标判断的判别效度
items.summaryZh: 本研究调查了 Watt-max 测试和评估者对心脏病患者 V̇O2max 达标判断的判别效度，这与心脏康复运动处方相关。
items.curatedReasonEn: The Watt-max Test and assessors' subjective judgment may not reliably predict V̇O2max in individuals with heart disease. When prescribing exercise for cardiopulmonary rehabilitation patients, interpret these results with caution; they should not be equated directly with actual V̇O2max.
items.limitation: 该研究缺乏关于 Watt-max 测试在不同心脏病亚型或严重程度人群中适用性的具体局限性信息。
items.limitationEn: The study lacks specific limitation information regarding the applicability of the Watt-max Test in different heart disease subtypes or severity populations.
items.journal: Archives of Physical Medicine and Rehabilitation

items.title: Exercise-based rehabilitation interventions for kinesiophobia after total knee arthroplasty: a systematic review and meta-analysis of randomized controlled trials.
items.summary: A systematic review of 11 RCTs (N=1,096) found that exercise-based rehabilitation was associated with a reduction in kinesiophobia (SMD = -1.22, 95% CI [-1.72, -0.72]) and improvements in knee function (SMD = 1.19, 95% CI [0.67, 1.71]) after total knee arthroplasty, although the certainty of evidence was low for both outcomes.
items.curatedReason: 本系统综述发现，运动康复能显著降低全膝关节置换术（TKA）患者的运动恐惧症（kinesiophobia）并改善膝关节功能，效应量分别为 SMD -1.22 和 1.19。尽管证据确定性为低，但这一结果支持在 TKA 术后康复中更积极地整合运动干预。
items.titleZh: 基于运动的康复干预对全膝关节置换术后运动恐惧症的影响：一项随机对照试验的系统综述和 Meta 分析
items.summaryZh: 一项纳入 11 项随机对照试验（N=1,096）的系统综述显示，基于运动的康复干预可显著降低全膝关节置换术后患者的运动恐惧症（SMD = -1.22）并改善膝关节功能（SMD = 1.19），但证据确定性较低。
items.curatedReasonEn: This systematic review found that exercise-based rehabilitation significantly reduced kinesiophobia (SMD -1.22) and improved knee function (SMD 1.19) after total knee arthroplasty (TKA). Despite low certainty of evidence, these findings support more active integration of exercise into TKA post-operative rehabilitation.
items.limitation: 该综述证据确定性低，且存在显著异质性及偏倚风险，短期疼痛结局不稳健。
items.limitationEn: The review has low certainty of evidence, significant heterogeneity, and risk of bias, with non-robust short-term pain outcomes.

items.title: Factors associated with Severe Balance Impairment After Right-Hemisphere Stroke: The Role of Spatial Neglect and Lateropulsion: A Secondary Analysis of Multicenter Cross-Sectional Study POSTIM.
items.summary: In 82 right-hemisphere stroke patients with postural asymmetry, 74% had severe balance impairment (BBS <45/56). Spatial neglect (OR 11.15), lateropulsion (OR 3.54), and lower-limb motor deficit (OR 0.91) were independently associated with severe balance impairment.
items.curatedReason: 右半球卒中（RHS）患者即使恢复了无支撑站立，仍有高比例存在严重的平衡障碍，且与空间忽视和躯体偏斜独立相关。在评估和干预 RHS 患者的平衡障碍时，你应着重筛查并针对这些神经心理因素。
items.titleZh: 右半球卒中后严重平衡障碍的相关因素：空间忽视和躯体偏斜的作用：一项多中心横断面研究 POSTIM 的次要分析
items.summaryZh: 在 82 例伴有姿势不对称的右半球卒中患者中，74% 存在严重平衡障碍（BBS <45/56）。空间忽视（OR 11.15）、躯体偏斜（OR 3.54）和下肢运动缺陷（OR 0.91）与严重平衡障碍独立相关。
items.curatedReasonEn: A high proportion of right-hemisphere stroke (RHS) patients experience severe balance impairment even after recovering unsupported standing, and this is independently associated with spatial neglect and lateropulsion. When assessing and intervening in balance deficits for RHS patients, you should prioritize screening for and addressing these neuropsychological factors.
items.limitation: 这是一项回顾性横断面分析，无法建立因果关系，且患者样本量有限。
items.limitationEn: This is a retrospective cross-sectional analysis, precluding causal inference, and has a limited patient sample size.

items.title: Convergent validity of the Functional Bridge Test and its prognostic association with walking independence in patients with acute stroke: a retrospective cohort study.
items.summary: The Functional Bridge Test (FBT) demonstrated adequate convergent validity with NIHSS (ρ = -0.668) and FSS-ICU scores (ρ = 0.730) and was independently associated with walking independence (adjusted OR = 1.786, 95% CI = 1.022-3.418) in 207 patients with acute stroke.
items.curatedReason: 功能性搭桥测试（FBT）与 NIHSS 评分和 FSS-ICU 评分有良好关联性，并且独立预测卒中患者的步行独立性。这个简单易行的床旁评估工具在急性卒中患者中具有不错的效度和预后价值，值得你考虑作为常规评估手段。
items.titleZh: 功能性搭桥测试的聚合效度及其与急性卒中患者步行独立性的预后关联：一项回顾性队列研究
items.summaryZh: 功能性搭桥测试（FBT）在 207 例急性卒中患者中，与 NIHSS 评分（ρ = -0.668）和 FSS-ICU 评分（ρ = 0.730）显示出良好的聚合效度，并且与步行独立性独立相关（调整后 OR = 1.786）。
items.curatedReasonEn: The Functional Bridge Test (FBT) shows good correlation with NIHSS and FSS-ICU scores and independently predicts walking independence in stroke patients. This simple bedside assessment tool has decent validity and prognostic value for acute stroke, making it a worthy addition to your routine assessments.
items.limitation: 这是一项回顾性队列研究，且随访终点基于出院时间而非标准化时间点，可能存在选择偏倚。
items.limitationEn: This was a retrospective cohort study with a variable discharge-based endpoint, which may introduce selection bias.

items.title: Robotic Assessment of Thumb Proprioception after Stroke: Reliability, Validity, and Sensitivity.
items.summary: A novel robotic assessment (SCJ) for thumb proprioception in chronic stroke survivors demonstrated good reliability, validity, and sensitivity, identifying deficits in 61% of participants, significantly more than the FMA-S.
items.curatedReason: 中风后腕部本体感觉评估，用了新器械，比老方法（FMA-S）更能查出问题，是给康复的定心丸。
items.titleZh: 机器人评估中风后拇指本体感觉：可靠性、有效性与敏感性
items.summaryZh: 一种新颖的机器人评估工具（SCJ）用于评估中风后慢性期患者的拇指本体感觉，显示出良好的可靠性、有效性和敏感性，能识别出61%的患者存在本体感觉缺陷，远高于FMA-S。
items.curatedReasonEn: The development of a reliable, valid, and sensitive robotic assessment for thumb proprioception post-stroke is a significant advancement. This tool's ability to detect deficits in a higher percentage of patients than traditional measures like the FMA-S will likely improve the characterization of sensory impairments and inform more targeted rehabilitation strategies.
items.limitation: 本研究使用了临床试验的基线数据和特定的机器人评估（SCJ），需要在更广泛的卒中人群中进一步验证，并与其他高级评估工具进行比较。
items.limitationEn: The study used baseline data from a clinical trial and a specific robotic assessment (SCJ), requiring further validation in broader stroke populations and comparison with other advanced assessment tools.
items.journal: Archives of physical medicine and rehabilitation

related.title: Robotic Assessment of Thumb Proprioception after Stroke: Reliability, Validity, and Sensitivity

items.title: Prone positioning and high-frequency oscillatory ventilation in early paediatric acute respiratory distress syndrome (PROSpect): an international, two-by-two factorial, response-adaptive, phase 3, randomised controlled trial
items.summary: The PROSpect trial found no evidence that prone positioning or HFOV improve ventilator-free days in early, moderate-to-severe PARDS, recommending against their routine use as first-line strategies.
items.curatedReason: 重症新生儿呼吸窘迫综合征（PARDS），俯卧位和高频振荡通气（HFOV）不是首选，别常规用了。
items.titleZh: 俯卧位和高频振荡通气在早期儿童急性呼吸窘迫综合征（PROSpect）：一项国际性、2x2 析因、反应适应性、III 期、随机对照试验
items.summaryZh: PROSpect试验未发现俯卧位或高频振荡通气能改善早期、中重度儿童急性呼吸窘迫综合征（PARDS）的无通气天数，因此不推荐将其作为一线策略常规使用。
items.curatedReasonEn: The PROSpect trial provides high-level evidence that prone positioning and HFOV are not recommended as first-line strategies for early, moderate-to-severe PARDS, directly impacting clinical guidelines and practice for pediatric critical care. This finding challenges previous assumptions and directs care toward alternative approaches.
items.limitation: 本研究侧重于早期、中度至重度PARDS，并以脱离呼吸机天数作为主要结局，研究结果可能无法直接推广至其他PARDS严重程度或不同的结局指标。
items.limitationEn: The study focused on early, moderate-to-severe PARDS and used ventilator-free days as the primary outcome, and findings may not directly translate to other PARDS severity levels or different outcome measures.

items.title: Discussing pain increases at the point of exercise prescription: a clinical commentary for persistent musculoskeletal conditions.
items.summary: A clinical commentary suggests that clinicians should proactively discuss potential symptom aggravation with patients when prescribing exercise for persistent musculoskeletal pain, as current evidence does not support universal pain-monitoring rules.
items.curatedReason: 别迷信疼痛阈值，跟患者说清楚练了可能痛，让他们自己做好准备。

items.curatedReasonEn: This commentary provides a crucial clinical framework for addressing exercise-induced pain in persistent musculoskeletal conditions. It emphasizes proactive patient education and shared decision-making rather than relying on unproven universal pain thresholds, which is essential for improving adherence and confidence.

items.limitationEn: The commentary is based on qualitative reasoning and a review of existing literature, with a call for future research to validate specific instructions and communication strategies.

items.title: Calibrating clinical reasoning under uncertainty: a qualitative study of expert physiotherapists in musculoskeletal practice.
items.summary: Expert physiotherapists use flexible clinical scripts, calibrate judgment with diverse cues, and employ provisional decisions to manage uncertainty in musculoskeletal practice, transforming ambiguity into actionable clinical judgments.
items.curatedReason: 这项观察研究提示，在面对骨科不确定性时，专家倾向于灵活运用临床脚本、结合多种线索校准判断，并给出初步的治疗决策。这为你处理类似模糊情况提供了借鉴，但仍需更多高质量研究来证实其普适性。
items.titleZh: 在不确定性下校准临床推理：一项针对肌肉骨骼实践中专家物理治疗师的定性研究
items.summaryZh: 专家物理治疗师通过灵活运用临床脚本、结合多种线索校准判断以及采取暂时性决策来管理不确定性，从而将模糊情况转化为可操作的临床判断。
items.curatedReasonEn: This observational study suggests that experts navigate musculoskeletal uncertainty using flexible clinical scripts, calibrating judgment with diverse cues, and employing provisional decisions. While offering a potential framework for managing ambiguity, more robust research is needed to generalize these findings.
items.limitation: 本研究依赖于对假设性情景的书面论证，且样本量小，仅涉及少数高度专业化的专家，限制了特定推理策略的普适性。
items.limitationEn: The study relies on written justifications for hypothetical vignettes and involves a small sample of highly specialized experts, limiting the generalizability of specific reasoning strategies.

items.title: The cost-effectiveness of motivational interviewing to activate pain support in veterans seeking compensation for musculoskeletal conditions: multisite randomised clinical trial
items.summary: A multisite randomized clinical trial (n=1101) found that a motivational interviewing intervention costing $300 per participant increased the use of physical therapy and other musculoskeletal services, raising healthcare system costs by $US1,508 (p<0.001), but had no significant effect on total societal costs or preference-rated quality of life over 36 weeks, thus not being cost-effective in the short-term.
items.curatedReason: 一项针对退伍军人的多中心随机临床试验发现，动机性访谈虽然增加了物理治疗、脊柱手法、针灸等服务的使用，但也显著增加了医疗系统成本。鉴于其对生活质量的无显著影响且短期内不具成本效益，临床实践中应审慎评估其价值。
items.titleZh: 动机性访谈在激活寻求肌肉骨骼疾病补偿的退伍军人疼痛支持中的成本效益：一项多中心随机临床试验
items.summaryZh: 一项多中心随机临床试验（n=1101）发现，每位参与者花费 300 美元的动机性访谈干预增加了物理治疗及其他肌肉骨骼服务的使用，使医疗系统成本增加 1,508 美元（p<0.001），但对总社会成本或偏好评定的生活质量在 36 周内无显著影响，因此短期内不具成本效益。
items.curatedReasonEn: A multisite RCT in veterans found that motivational interviewing increased the use of PT, spinal manipulation, and acupuncture but significantly raised healthcare system costs. Given no significant impact on quality of life and short-term non-cost-effectiveness, its value in clinical practice warrants careful consideration.
items.limitation: 该试验的成本效益评估仅限于 36 周的短期随访，长期效果和成本效益尚不明确。
items.limitationEn: The cost-effectiveness evaluation in this trial was limited to a short 36-week follow-up, leaving long-term effects and cost-effectiveness unknown.

items.summary: Effective January 1, 2027, CPT code 92507 for speech-language therapy will be deleted and replaced by ten new, more specific codes covering fluency, speech sound production, language, and voice/upper airway disorders, according to the AMA's CPT Editorial Panel.
items.curatedReason: WebPT 发布的这则新闻非常关键：自 2027 年 1 月 1 日起，言语语言治疗 CPT 代码 92507 将被废止，并被十个更具体的代码取代。虽然是 SLP 相关，但它标志着美国医疗编码体系的重大变化，对你理解跨专业诊疗、尤其是涉及联合报销的 PT 执业具有重要参考意义。

While SLP-specific, it marks a significant change in US medical coding, offering important insights for your understanding of interprofessional practice, especially regarding joint reimbursement.

items.title: Efficacy of whole-body vibration training in the management of patients with COPD: a systematic review and meta-analysis.
items.summary: A systematic review and meta-analysis of 15 RCTs found that whole-body vibration training significantly improved 6-minute walk distance (MD = 34.35 m; 95% CI: 13.67, 55.04) and 5-repetition sit-to-stand test performance (MD = -5.95 seconds; 95% CI: -10.76, -1.14) in COPD patients compared to usual care, but not when compared to active exercise interventions.
items.curatedReason: 全身体振动训练（WBVT）对 COPD 患者的益处有限，仅在与无康复对照组相比时才观察到步距和坐站能力的改善。不应将其作为常规运动康复的替代方案。
items.titleZh: 全身体振动训练对 COPD 患者管理疗效的系统评价和荟萃分析
items.summaryZh: 一项包含 15 项随机对照试验的系统综述和荟萃分析发现，全身体振动训练能显著改善 COPD 患者的 6 分钟步行距离（平均差 = 34.35 米；95% CI：13.67，55.04）和 5 次坐站测试表现（平均差 = -5.95 秒；95% CI：-10.76，-1.14），但仅在与常规护理相比时有效，与主动运动干预相比则无显著差异。
items.curatedReasonEn: Whole-body vibration training (WBVT) shows limited benefits for COPD patients, with improvements in walking distance and sit-to-stand performance observed only when compared to no rehabilitation. It should not replace conventional exercise-based pulmonary rehabilitation.
items.limitation: 纳入研究存在高偏倚风险，证据确定性为低到极低。
items.limitationEn: Included studies had a high risk of bias, and evidence certainty ranged from low to very low.

items.title: Dizziness, Lower Limb Weakness, and Falls in COPD: A Prospective Longitudinal Pilot Study Using Monthly Home Diaries.
items.summary: A prospective longitudinal pilot study (n=27) found that monthly home diary monitoring of dizziness and lower limb weakness showed higher apparent discrimination for predicting falls in COPD patients than single-visit baseline assessments, with dizziness having the strongest discrimination (AUC = 0.813).
items.curatedReason: 对于 COPD 患者，每月通过日记监测头晕和下肢无力等症状，可能比单次评估更能有效识别跌倒风险，这提示了一种低成本的补充性筛查方法。
items.titleZh: COPD 患者的头晕、下肢无力和跌倒：一项使用每月居家日记的前瞻性纵向初步研究
items.summaryZh: 一项前瞻性纵向初步研究（n=27）发现，每月通过居家日记监测头晕和下肢无力，在预测 COPD 患者跌倒方面的区分度高于单次基线评估，其中头晕的区分度最强（AUC = 0.813）。
items.curatedReasonEn: For COPD patients, monthly diary-recorded symptom monitoring (e.g., dizziness, lower limb weakness) may offer better fall risk discrimination than single-visit assessments, suggesting a low-cost, complementary screening approach.
items.limitation: 这是一项小样本的初步观察性研究（n=27），结果具有探索性且可能存在偏倚。
items.limitationEn: This was a small pilot observational study (n=27), making the findings exploratory and potentially biased.
items.journal: Physiotherapy research international : the journal for researchers and clinicians in physical therapy

items.title: Interprofessional communication and early rehabilitation practices in orthopaedic surgery: a cross-sectional survey
items.summary: A cross-sectional survey of 84 orthopedic surgeons and 513 physiotherapists in Türkiye revealed that despite 96.4% of surgeons acknowledging the importance of early physiotherapy, only 27.4% reported initiation within 0-3 postoperative days, and nearly half of both groups reported low direct communication.
items.curatedReason: 尽管骨科医生和物理治疗师都认识到早期康复的重要性，但本研究揭示了土耳其在术后康复启动时间及医患沟通实践上的显著差异，提示行业在标准化流程和跨专业协作上仍有待改进。
items.titleZh: 骨科手术中的跨专业沟通与早期康复实践：一项横断面调查
items.summaryZh: 一项针对土耳其 84 名骨科医生和 513 名物理治疗师的横断面调查显示，尽管 96.4% 的外科医生认识到早期物理治疗的重要性，但只有 27.4% 的人报告在术后 0-3 天内开始康复，且近半数受访者表示直接沟通不足。
items.curatedReasonEn: Despite awareness of early rehabilitation's importance, this study highlights significant variations in post-operative rehabilitation timing and interprofessional communication practices in Türkiye, suggesting a need for improved standardization and collaboration.
items.limitation: 这是一项横断面调查，只能揭示相关性而非因果关系，且可能存在回忆偏倚。
items.limitationEn: This is a cross-sectional survey, which can only show correlations, not causation, and may be subject to recall bias.

items.title: How ChoosePT Turns PTs' Expertise Into Trusted Public Resources

items.curatedReason: 在向患者家庭解释儿童物理治疗时，你可以直接引用 APTA 的 ChoosePT.com。这个网站内容经过专家评审，能为家长提供可靠的循证信息，省去了你自行寻找科普素材的时间。

items.title: Validation and prognostic value of the five-repetition sit-to-stand test in patients with severe exacerbation of COPD.
items.summary: A prospective observational study (n=58) found the 5STS test correlated with quadriceps force (r = -0.487) and 6MWT (r = -0.415) in severe ECOPD patients, showing acceptable prognostic value (AUC 0.720, 95% CI: 0.588-0.853) for predicting 6-month exacerbation-related readmission with a ≥13 seconds cutoff.
items.curatedReason: 五次坐站测试（5STS）在评估慢性阻塞性肺疾病急性加重患者的功能和预测再入院风险方面显示出潜力。这为临床 PT 提供了一个简单、低成本的评估工具，帮助识别高风险患者。
items.titleZh: 五次坐站测试在重度慢性阻塞性肺疾病急性加重患者中的验证和预后价值
items.summaryZh: 一项前瞻性观察研究（n=58）显示，五次坐站测试（5STS）与股四头肌力量（r = -0.487）和六分钟步行测试（r = -0.415）在重度慢性阻塞性肺疾病急性加重患者中存在显著负相关，且具有可接受的预后价值（AUC 0.720，95% CI: 0.588-0.853），能预测六个月内再入院风险，临界值为≥13秒。
items.curatedReasonEn: The five-repetition sit-to-stand (5STS) test demonstrates potential for assessing physical function and predicting readmission risk in patients with severe exacerbation of COPD. This provides a simple, low-cost assessment tool for clinical physical therapists to identify high-risk patients.
items.limitation: 本研究为单中心观察性研究，样本量较小（n=58），可能影响结果的普遍性，且未报告干预效果。
items.limitationEn: This was a single-center observational study with a small sample size (n=58), which may limit the generalizability of the findings and did not report intervention effects.

items.title: Predicting Robot-Based Tracking Performance After Stroke Using Lesion Features and Clinical Assessments: A Pilot Study
items.summary: A pilot study (n=18) found clinical assessments significantly predicted robot-based tracking error (R^2=0.45) in chronic stroke patients, outperforming lesion features. Attention- and motor-related measures were identified as the strongest predictors.
items.curatedReason: 这项初步研究表明，临床评估在预测卒中后机器人辅助追踪表现方面优于单纯的病灶特征。临床PT可继续关注患者的运动和认知功能，将其作为康复预后的关键指标，并期待未来更大样本的研究提供更精确的影像预测价值。
items.titleZh: 基于病灶特征和临床评估预测卒中后机器人辅助追踪表现：一项初步研究
items.summaryZh: 一项初步研究（n=18）发现，在慢性卒中患者中，临床评估显著预测机器人辅助追踪误差（R^2=0.45），优于单纯的病灶特征。注意力与运动相关指标被确定为最强预测因子。
items.curatedReasonEn: This pilot study suggests that clinical assessments are superior to lesion features alone in predicting robot-based tracking performance after stroke. Clinical PTs should continue to prioritize motor and cognitive functional assessments as key indicators for rehabilitation prognosis, while awaiting larger studies for more precise imaging predictive value.
items.limitation: 本研究为小样本（n=18）探索性试点研究，且关注的是机器人辅助追踪表现的替代终点，其结果外推至真实世界功能性康复效果需谨慎。
items.limitationEn: This was a small-sample (n=18) exploratory pilot study focusing on a surrogate endpoint of robot-based tracking performance; therefore, generalizing these results to real-world functional rehabilitation outcomes should be done with caution.

items.title: Implementing low-cost Capability, Opportunity Motivation and Behaviour (COM-B) interventions to increase bed-substitution rehabilitation referrals in acute stroke care.
items.summary: Low-cost COM-B interventions increased bed-substitution rehabilitation referrals in acute stroke care from 5.6% to 9.6% (p = 0.002) over 12 months in a study of 1146 patients (median age 65, 53% male).
items.curatedReason: 这项实施研究成功地通过COM-B模型干预将急性卒中患者的床位替代康复转诊率从5.6%提高到9.6% (p = 0.002)。这为你改进康复转诊流程提供了实际案例和数据支持。
items.titleZh: 在急性卒中护理中实施低成本能力、机会、动机和行为（COM-B）干预措施以增加床位替代康复转诊
items.summaryZh: 一项对1146名患者（中位年龄65岁，53%男性）的研究显示，低成本COM-B干预措施在12个月内将急性卒中护理中床位替代康复转诊率从5.6%提高到9.6% (p = 0.002)。
items.curatedReasonEn: This implementation study successfully increased bed-substitution rehabilitation referrals for acute stroke patients from 5.6% to 9.6% (p = 0.002) using COM-B model interventions. This offers practical insights and data to improve your rehabilitation referral processes.
items.limitation: 单一中心的实施研究，结果外推性有限。
items.limitationEn: This is a single-center implementation study, limiting the generalizability of its findings.

items.title: The effects of stretching interventions in people with multiple sclerosis: a systematic review.
items.summary: A systematic review of 7 studies (144 participants, 44.5 ± 9.6 years) found descriptively favorable changes after stretching in PwMS, with some outcomes (Timed Up and Go, flexibility, spasticity, pain, fatigue) meeting minimal important change, but evidence certainty was very low (GRADE).
items.curatedReason: 尽管证据确定性仍为“非常低”，但该系统综述提示拉伸干预可能改善多发性硬化症（MS）患者的活动能力、痉挛、疼痛和疲劳。在制定综合康复策略时，你可以考虑将其作为辅助手段。
items.titleZh: 拉伸干预对多发性硬化症患者的影响：一项系统综述
items.summaryZh: 一项对7项研究（144名参与者，44.5 ± 9.6岁）的系统综述发现，多发性硬化症患者在拉伸后出现描述性有利变化，部分结局（计时起立行走、柔韧性、痉挛、疼痛、疲劳）达到最小临床重要改变，但证据确定性非常低（GRADE）。
items.curatedReasonEn: Although the certainty of evidence remains "very low," this systematic review suggests that stretching interventions may improve mobility, spasticity, pain, and fatigue in people with multiple sclerosis (MS). You can consider incorporating it as an adjunct in comprehensive rehabilitation strategies.
items.limitation: 纳入研究数量少（7项，144名参与者），且拉伸常作为对照而非主要干预，导致证据确定性非常低。
items.limitationEn: The review included a small number of studies (7 studies, 144 participants), and stretching was often an active comparator or control, leading to very low certainty of evidence.

items.title: Effect of Incorporating Perceptual Learning Into Plantar Hardness Discrimination on the Risk of Falling and Muscle Torque in Patients With Hemiplegia: A Randomized Controlled Trial.
items.summary: A randomized controlled trial (n=34) found that incorporating perceptual learning into plantar hardness discrimination significantly reduced fall risk (P <0.001, ES=1.48), increased knee extensors torque (P <0.001, ES=1.19), and improved FIM scores (P <0.001, ES=1.56) in hemiplegic stroke patients compared to a control group.
items.curatedReason: 这项 RCT 表明，在偏瘫患者的康复方案中加入足底硬度辨别知觉学习，能显著降低跌倒风险、增强膝伸肌扭矩并改善功能独立性。这为你优化卒中康复训练提供了明确的循证依据，尤其是在平衡和下肢力量方面。
items.titleZh: 偏瘫患者足底硬度辨别知觉学习对跌倒风险和肌肉扭矩影响的随机对照试验
items.summaryZh: 一项随机对照试验（n=34）发现，在偏瘫患者的康复方案中加入足底硬度辨别知觉学习，与对照组相比，显著降低了跌倒风险（P <0.001, ES=1.48）、增加了膝伸肌扭矩（P <0.001, ES=1.19），并改善了 FIM 评分（P <0.001, ES=1.56）。
items.curatedReasonEn: This RCT indicates that incorporating perceptual learning with plantar hardness discrimination into rehabilitation programs for hemiplegic patients significantly reduces fall risk, enhances knee extensor torque, and improves functional independence. This provides clear evidence to optimize stroke rehabilitation, particularly regarding balance and lower limb strength.
items.limitation: 研究样本量较小（34 例），且随访期短，结果的长期稳定性和普适性需更多研究验证。
items.limitationEn: The study had a small sample size (34 patients) and short follow-up, so long-term stability and generalizability of results require further validation.
